setup_notes: Windowed 1280x720 needs the Steam launch options: windowed width=1280 height=720 (NO dashes on windowed; measured 2026-09-29: borderless window at the top-left, desktop left at 1920x1080). '-windowed' is ignored and '-width 1280 -height 720' switches the whole screen to 1280x720 fullscreen.
2026-09-29 (Tefa): both videos before play (the pre-gameplay video and the one before the back alley with the gate) skip with Enter; the last wait re-presses Enter every 3 s until the HUD shows.

brief.why: Get from a closed game to Alex in the city, in your control, with no help, so every test starts the same way.
brief.start: Game closed. Claude launches it and says LISTENING once the recorder is live; press nothing before that.
move: On each screen, BEFORE doing anything: Page Up if it needs a key (then press it), Page Down if it just needs waiting for.
Go through the logos and menus the way you normally would, to loading your save.
When Alex is standing in the game and you could move him: Page Down once more.
brief.screen: Only the game window in front.
brief.avoid: Moving Alex, the pause menu, extra keys after arriving.
brief.end: End to stop recording (Home undoes a mark pressed by mistake).
